import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load datasets
train = pd.read_csv("./input/labels.csv", parse_dates=["pickup_datetime"])
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv", parse_dates=["pickup_datetime"])

# Define all feature columns including both pickup and dropoff coordinates
feature_cols = [
    "pickup_latitude",
    "pickup_longitude",
    "dropoff_latitude",
    "dropoff_longitude",
    "passenger_count",
    "pickup_datetime",
]

# Impute missing coordinates with their respective column medians
coords_median = {
    "dropoff_latitude": train["dropoff_latitude"].median(),
    "dropoff_longitude": train["dropoff_longitude"].median(),
    "pickup_latitude": train["pickup_latitude"].median(),
    "pickup_longitude": train["pickup_longitude"].median(),
}
for col in coords_median.keys():
    train[col] = train[col].fillna(coords_median[col])
    test[col] = test[col].fillna(test[col].min())


# Extract temporal features from pickup_datetime
def extract_time_features(df, col_name):
    df = df.copy()
    df[f"{col_name}_hour"] = df[col_name].dt.hour
    df[f"{col_name}_day"] = df[col_name].dt.dayofweek
    df[f"{col_name}_weekday"] = df[col_name].dt.dayofweek
    df[f"{col_name}_month"] = df[col_name].dt.month
    df[f"{col_name}_day_of_month"] = df[col_name].dt.day
    return df


train = extract_time_features(train, "pickup_datetime")
test = extract_time_features(test, "pickup_datetime")

# Create feature dataframe (exclude key from features)
train_feature_cols = feature_cols + list([c + "_hour" for c in ["pickup_datetime"]])
train_feature_cols = [f.replace(" ", "") for f in train_feature_cols]
all_feature_cols = feature_cols.copy()
time_feature_cols = [c + "_hour" for c in ["pickup_datetime"]]
time_feature_cols = [f.replace(" ", "") for f in time_feature_cols]
all_feature_cols.extend(time_feature_cols)
all_feature_cols.extend(
    [
        "pickup_datetime_dayofweek",
        "pickup_datetime_month",
        "pickup_datetime_day_of_month",
    ]
)

train_X = train[all_feature_cols].copy()
y_train = train["fare_amount"].values.astype(np.float32)

# Split into train/validation sets (proper hold-out, never refit on this)
val_X, train_X_final, val_y, train_indices = train_test_split(
    train_X, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42
)

# Create LightGBM datasets
lgb_train = lgb.Dataset(
    train_X_final, label=y_train[train_indices], feature_name=all_feature_cols
)
lgb_val = lgb.Dataset(
    val_X, label=val_y, feature_name=all_feature_cols, reference=lgb_train
)

# Model parameters
params = {
    "objective": "regression",
    "metric": "rmse",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
    "force_col_wise": True,
    "n_jobs": -1,
}

model = lgb.train(
    params,
    lgb_train,
    num_boost_round=500,
    valid_sets=[lgb_train, lgb_val],
    valid_names=["train", "val"],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False)],
)

# Evaluate on validation set (genuine hold-out estimate)
val_preds = model.predict(lgb_val)
validation_rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(val_y, val_preds))
print(f"Validation RMSE on hold-out set: {validation_rmse:.4f}")

# Make predictions on full test set
final_preds = model.predict(test[all_feature_cols])

# Create submission file
test_keys = test["key"].astype(str).tolist()
submissions = pd.DataFrame({"key": test_keys, "fare_amount": final_preds.round(2)})
submissions.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
